description: Artists can claim a free page with all their direct-support links in one place.

title: Browser extension
description: Browser extensions for Chrome and Firefox! See direct-support links for whatever artist you're listening to on Spotify or Apple Music.

title: Release alerts
description: Save artists in the Mac app or browser extension and get notified when they drop something new. No more missing releases from the artists you care about.
